Our Utility Cleaners play an important role in support of a number of vital hotel functions. At our hotels these associates may work across departments (e.g., kitchen, food and beverage, laundry) to support cleaning needs. Whether preparing fresh clean linen and spotless dining ware for guests to enjoy, operating and maintaining cleaning equipment and tools (e.g., dish washing machines, hand wash stations, linen washers and dryers), or transporting dishware or linens across the hotel, these associates do whatever it takes to get the job done.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards, develop and maintain positive working relationships with other employees and departments, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
q: Education: No high school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

d: Role Description This is a part-time, hybrid Sales Executive / Business Development Executive role based in Ash Sharqiyah South Governorate, Oman, with some flexibility to work from home. The role involves identifying new business opportunities, reaching out to potential client organizations, and promoting the agency’s recruitment services. Daily tasks include prospecting and qualifying leads, scheduling and attending client meetings, preparing proposals, and maintaining accurate records in CRM or tracking systems. The executive will collaborate with internal teams to understand hiring requirements, follow up on leads, and build long-term client relationships. The role also includes monitoring market trends, contributing to sales targets, and representing the agency in a professional manner.
q: Demonstrated sales or business development skills, including lead generation, prospecting, and relationship management.
Strong communication and negotiation abilities, with confident presentation and client-facing skills.
Organizational and time-management skills, with the capacity to manage multiple leads and follow-ups in a part-time schedule.
Basic understanding of recruitment or HR services, or willingness to quickly learn the recruitment industry.
Proficiency with common office software and CRM tools, and comfort working in a hybrid environment.
Ability to work independently, meet agreed targets, and collaborate effectively with a distributed team.
Previous experience in sales, business development, or customer service is preferred.
Relevant diploma or degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is beneficial, though equivalent experience may be considered
